scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Launch out/chatform-launch.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --crf 16 --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.master: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/chatform-launch.mp4 -af "loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=7,alimiter=limit=0.84:level=false" -vf "scale=out_range=tv:out_color_matrix=bt709,format=yuv420p" -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 17 -profile:v high -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/chatform-launch-x.mp4
scripts.build: npm run sfx-manifest && npm run render && npm run master
scripts.preview: remotion render src/index.ts Launch out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --codec h264 --crf 23
